title: Return instruction semantics
statement: Let a nondeterministic register program with oracle, input, and guard be fixed. If the instruction at state $l$ returns the Boolean value $b$ and the guard holds at the configuration with state $l$, register values $v$, and no answer recorded, then this configuration has terminating semantics whose acceptance condition is exactly $b=\mathrm{true}$.
